prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Miniature Beasts Station screen concept, the LIBRARY's SPECIMEN CASE screen (the whole collection of species seen at a glance as a glazed entomologist's case of unit trays), a flat screen design that fills the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge; keep every piece of text at least 60 px inside the left and right edges (the outer 2 percent is bleed, trimmed later to 1024x600). Not a device photograph: no bezel, no buttons, no hands. Design at 1024x600 first: large shapes, few words.
VIBE: a naturalist's SPECIMEN CASE seen straight from above through its glass lid: an ebonised dark-wood frame with brass corner caps, one glass lid with a single soft reflection running from the upper left, a pale linen floor, shallow unit trays with pale card walls that cast short shadows, small cream cards standing proud on mounts, paper tags on brass pins; real depth, material and shadow, a cataloguing hand; quiet. Cool, even light from the upper left, short shadows to the lower right, nothing warm. NOT paper pages, not a book, not flat tiles. The top bar and bottom line are the instrument's own graphite strips, exactly as on the supplied Home screen: the same smooth sans-serif type (like Inter), the same bolt, diamond and drop counters, the same bottom-line grammar. Clean painted light, crisp edges, no noise or dither. The only words are the few listed.
LAYOUT, as the template. THE CASE fills the stage: an ebonised dark-wood frame with small brass caps at its four corners, a single glass lid over the whole case (one soft diagonal reflection from the upper left, nothing else on the glass), and inside it a pale, finely woven LINEN floor. UPPER LEFT, FOUR CLAN TRAYS in a two-by-two block, each a shallow unit tray with pale card walls and a thin lip casting a short shadow onto the linen, and a thin strip along its top edge in that tray's own colour exactly as in the template (moss green, coral, lagoon, slate violet). In each clan tray a small cream CARD standing a little proud on a low mount, and under the card a small paper TAG held by a brass pin through the tag's corner (the pin never touches the card): the first tray's card is a plain EMPTY cream card with a small gilt triangle at its top right corner (the creature is placed later); the second tray's card shows a small painted face of a round coral fluff under a cap of three flaps; the third tray's card shows a small painted lagoon-blue lizard with a crest and a tail ending in a glowing bulb, and this card is lifted inside a warm cream focus ring; the fourth tray's card carries only a soft, unfinished PENCIL field sketch in grey graphite of a sitting cat, a naturalist's quick sketch, no colour. All four tags are blank paper. TO THE RIGHT, ONE WIDE PLAIN TRAY with pale card walls and NO colour strip, holding twelve IDENTICAL bare places in two rows of six: each a low empty mount with a small brass pin and a blank paper tag under it, nothing on any mount, nothing to tell them apart. BELOW THE TRAYS, the lower half of the linen floor is bare, with only faint rectangular footprints pressed into the linen where more trays will sit. ALONG THE FOOT OF THE CASE, a brass-edged LEDGE in front of the glass: at its left a thread strung with sixteen tiny paper tags (the first three inked dark, the fourth pencilled light grey, the other twelve blank); in the middle a short engraved brass rule with a small brass slider a quarter of the way along; to the right a small round pin cushion with four pins whose heads are the four tray colours; at the far right a small brass plate, a quarter of it filled bright. No digits, no words anywhere on the case or the ledge.
TEXT, exactly these and nothing else: top bar left "Library  T5"; top bar centre a yellow lightning bolt "7", a blue diamond "3", a green drop "2"; top bar right "Companion away · with Dot". Bottom line: orange "✓ Open · ← Home" at left, the middle left EMPTY, grey "a pod waits in the tray" at right. No species names anywhere: every paper tag is BLANK (names are placed later); no words or digits on the trays, cards, tags or the ledge.
Constraints: no digits except the three counters; nothing written on any tag, card or plate; the first clan tray's card is a plain, flat, EMPTY cream card (the creature is placed there later) with only a small gilt triangle at its top right corner; the twelve places in the wide plain tray are IDENTICAL bare mounts with blank tags and show no silhouette, shape, shadow of a creature, colour or hint of any kind; no pin passes through any creature or card picture, pins hold only the tags; no wood grain on the floor (it is linen); no paper pages; no people; no warm light or glow.
preamble: Reference images follow; their roles are stated. Image 1 is the approved Home screen: same device; take its top bar, bottom line, type and counters only. Image 2 is the Library's book that a card opens into: take only the drawing style of its specimen plates and its lizard for the found cards; nothing of its pages is on this screen. Image 3 is layout truth only: the boxes and labels show where each element sits at 1024x600; it is not a style reference.
